coordinate_frame: Original output/sw-probe/arm.glb global frame, right handed, +Y up. Same orientation and origin as SW arm assembly; web GLB preserves it.
mapping_source: Audited arm, final chain linkage and UWB subtree; engineer J0/J1 mounting assemblies and two separately classified external chain loops.
motor_policy: Complete source motor assemblies; rigid translation with the owning link, no internal separation.
belt_policy: CAD tooth segments joined into one belt part per link and belt specification.
explosion_policy: Compact functional overview, intact J4-J6 wrist. Local covers clear first; named assembly-axis stacks open second. Complete motor instances stay at their assembly locations. Bearings remain inspectable; fasteners follow qualified mounting bodies.

quality_policy.protected: Structural parts, motors, bearings, chains, gears and pulleys retain cleaned source tessellation. Screw/nut thread detail is limited to 600 triangles per source object.
quality_policy.normals: 35 degree smoothing; area-weighted planar normals except motors.
quality_policy.merge: Same material within rigid mounting bundles only.

motion.frame: Baked source CAD coordinates. D_child = D_parent T(p) R(axis,q) T(-p).
motion.wheel_coupling: q7 = q5 - q6; dependent branch, not an eighth independent axis.
motion.j0_evidence: engineer_mates [0-2,30-31,299-305,1109-1110]; gimbal_mates [39-45]. Inner ring/slip-ring shells/central sprocket fixed. Outer ring/chassis/motor carrier rotates. Input sprocket and adapter counter-rotate in carrier frame.
motion.uwb_evidence: sw-probe/arm_mates mates[12,14-16,19-21,271,275-276]. Upper 22T wheel and bracket counter-rotate by q2 about their own offset axis, not the J3 axis.
motion.limits: Illustrative finite joint windows, not calibrated hardware limits. Chain circulation, bearing rollers, slip-ring internal rotors and detailed internal motor/gear dynamics are not simulated.
